requirements.text: Implement real-time notifications for transactions, significant account activities, personalized spending alerts, fraud alerts, and bill payment reminders
Integrate biometric authentication (fingerprint and facial recognition) for secure logins and access to sensitive features
Enable instant card controls that allow customers to freeze and unfreeze their cards directly within the app

Create a streamlined in-app lending and credit application process, including features for overdraft increases and personal loans, with user-friendly design elements such as calculators and real-time updates
Ensure simultaneous access to both old and new app versions during the transition period
Implement a robust onboarding process with tutorials or guided tours for the new app
Provide clear communication to customers about the transition, including notifications about new features and timelines
Enhance customer support channels, including live chat and in-app assistance, to assist users during the transition
Establish a feedback mechanism to gather customer insights on the new app
Ensure seamless data migration for customers switching to the new app, with all historical transaction data and settings carried over
Ensure compliance with Central Bank regulations regarding consumer protection and responsible lending throughout the app's functionalities
